prerequisites: A general vision of engineering as provided by any degree in the industrial branch.

learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to integrate knowledge and face the complexity of formulating judgments based on information that, being incomplete or limited, includes reflections on the social and ethical responsibilities linked to the application of their knowledge and judgments.
Students will know how to communicate their conclusions and the knowledge and ultimate reasons that support them to specialized and non-specialized audiences clearly and unambiguously.

Evaluate the viability of new mechatronic products, based on their technological characteristics, manufacturing possibilities and other socio-economic factors related to their possible implementation.
Develop skills for working in cooperative and multidisciplinary technical teams.
Know the regulations and apply quality management techniques and tools in the design of mechatronic equipment and systems.
Students will be able to understand the complexity and diversity of mechatronic systems.
Students will be able to understand the need to jointly design mechanical components and the control system as strongly coupled elements.
Students will be able to know the life cycle of a mechatronic system, from the origin of the need to its operation in production.
Students will be able to know the applicable regulations in the field of mechatronics.

syllabus_topics: The life cycle of mechatronic products.
assessment_rules: For the ordinary January call, the course will be evaluated based on 80% assignments and 20% aptitude scale. Grammatical and spelling errors will negatively affect the grades of all submitted documents. Assignments will be individual. For extraordinary calls in May and June, and for differentiated evaluation, only assignments will be used, with a weight of 80%.
